text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — during the last deploy autoscale handoff we saw prefill fail on two new nodes. KV prefix hit-rate dropped ~82% -> 19% for ~45s, which cascaded into higher tail latencies and extra cost. Noticed around 1748789000. Need a quick plan and a repro run.

Priya Nair: I pulled the profiler + cache logs. Top-level observations: many misses are from prefix/key mismatch, not pure capacity. We're trimming request IDs down to 8 chars in the keying layer — collisions spike in high-cardinality traffic. Also saw warmers running serially against the node which delayed full prefill.

Marco Ruiz: +1 on collision hypothesis. Also: the deployer warmers run as part of the rollout CI job, they appear to push one prefix file at a time. When autoscaler scales up multiple nodes quickly the handoff window exposes the race. Proposal: (a) canonicalize prefix keying (sha1 -> 16 hex) to reduce accidental variation, (b) add a prewarm hook to the autoscaler that runs a short parallel seeding job before traffic routing, and (c) add a "seed-all" mode for first 30s of a node.

Alex Chen: Can you paste the exact warmers command used in the deployer job? Need to replicate locally for repro.

Priya Nair: Command from CI:
```
./warmers --mode=deploy --prefixes-file=/tmp/pfxs.txt --concurrency=8 --target-node=$NODE --ttl=300
```
Current CI uses concurrency=8 and launches warmers sequentially per node. Prefill metrics during the window: prefill.attempts=120, prefill.success=42, avg_prefill_latency_ms=180, observed_kv_collision_count=37.

Marco Ruiz: Also worth noting: the kernel/kernelswitch we merged two commits ago increased the cold-KV miss penalty (more context switches in the NVMe path). So misses are costlier now than before. We should run the same warmers with the old kernel to see delta.

Julian Park: Experiment plan I can run tomorrow morning:
- A: baseline (current keying + serial warmers)
- B: canonicalized keying (sha1-16) + serial warmers
- C: canonicalized keying + parallel prewarm (autoscaler hook)
- D: C + synthetic high-RPS probe (200 RPS for 60s) to stress-hand off
Metrics: kv.hit_rate, prefill.success, prefill.handoff_latency, tail P95/P99 token latency, CPU/GPU load on node. I'll tag each run with deploy_id and kernel_version. Who owns the deploy change PR?

Priya Nair: I will own the prefix canonicalization PR. Will add deterministic salt and unit tests. Also will expose a prefilling metric: prefill.handoff_latency_ms with deploy_id tag.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident 3172 created: autoscale-prefill-failure detected for cluster inference-prod-eu-west. Pager duty notified.

Alex Chen: Thanks team. After Julian's experiment, let's pair to run a small canary with the autoscaler prewarm hook enabled (feature-flagged). Also add a dashboard: "Prefill Handoff" with filters by deploy_id, kernel_version, and autoscale_event_id. Reconvene 1h after experiment results. :thumbsup:
